body.statement: For the active tangent construction, \(\bigcup_{v\in V}D_v^0=\mathbb R^d\). Every \(u\) fixes a weak sign for each active hyperplane, every zero sign belongs to all incident completions, and exact projection retains a semantic label. More generally, if \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\) and a compact \(C\) has distance at least \(\tau>0\) from every offset hyperplane \(c_j+a_j^{\prime}u=0\), then the centered local expansion implies that the lawful sampled-data label on \(C\) eventually equals the label generated by \(D_v^0(c)\). At \(c=0\) this is the label fan of \(\mathfrak G_0\). When there are no active cuts, the construction reduces to one global region for the unique retained semantic label, and the honest diameter minimax value is zero.
body.justification: This is the corrected sanity reduction: the limit fan is a global directional arrangement, not the infeasible image of \(p_0+Bu\).
body.gap: Standard LAN arguments localize smooth statistics but do not state this completed semantic-branch cover with equality-face bookkeeping.
body.consumer: The proposition validates \(\mathfrak G_0\)'s global cover and tells the Job Corps transfer exactly where lawful finite-sample labels coincide with the tangent encoding.

obligation.what_is_open: After adjudication of the proposed local compatible-law neighborhood, prove that every tangent direction admits a legal optimal symbolic completion and hence a semantic cell.
obligation.obstruction: Multinomial interiority concerns only observed cell probabilities. Even \(\mathcal F(p_0)\ne\varnothing\) permits \(p_0\) to lie on the boundary of the observable causal model, where some \(Bu\) directions have no feasible endpoint program.
obligation.attempted: Weak-sign and equality-face completion proves the cover conditional on existence of one feasible optimal completion at each direction. The proposed relative-interior condition is a model-level, noncircular way to obtain it.
obligation.partial_result: Whenever a feasible optimal symbolic completion exists at \(u\), assigning every active cut its weak sign and assigning equality to all incident sides places \(u\) in a completed cell and hence in some \(D_v^0\).  The proposed local relative-interior condition for the compatible observed-law set yields feasible nearby endpoint programs along every direction and is the noncircular route to such a completion.  Without that condition, \(\mathcal F(p_0)\ne\varnothing\) alone need not make an arbitrary direction \(Bu\) tangent to the observable causal model.
